_comment: Sources for the Secret Society Infiltration Map wire. Same format as the Drug Underworld Map feeds.json: 'editions' are Google News country editions read with the query set for their language; 'searches' are global queries. Google News ANDs bare words, so each query is parenthesised OR groups: one organisation group, one institution group, one predicate group.

en: (freemason OR masonic OR "secret society" OR "Opus Dei" OR "Unification Church" OR Scientology OR "Gulen movement" OR "Muslim Brotherhood") (minister OR parliament OR police OR judge OR lawmaker OR government OR official OR prosecutor) (infiltrated OR infiltration OR ban OR banned OR dissolution OR inquiry OR members OR ties OR interference OR purge)
